text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oaks. Arriving at the venue 
early, before entering the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me, but could I have a moment 
of your time?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Before running, I want to take in the 
atmosphere of the venue. We still have 
time, right?"

...She might be unusually nervous. For 
now, I decided to listen to her request.

"It was still before Race 1— yet a 
respectable crowd had already gathered in 
the stands."

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"We might just witness history in the 
making today. A mother-daughter Oaks 
sweep—I gotta see this with my own eyes~!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really want Air Groove to win the 
Yushun Himba.

One could easily sense the crowd's immense 
interest in the Oaks... or rather, in Air 
Groove herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder what feelings Mother harbored 
when she faced this very 'Oaks.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And so, when "that day" actually 
arrives... I uncharacteristically find 
myself lost in thought.

"Indeed, it is rare for Air Groove to 
express her inner thoughts aloud like 
this..."
choice_data_list: Have you never asked your mother about it?
Have you never asked your mother about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I did ask once when I was very young. 
At that time, my mother replied like 
this."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—"If you're so curious, why don't you run 
in the Oaks too, Air Groove?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If I challenge her with all my might, I'm 
sure Air Groove will understand my 
feelings."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What is it, you? Why are you making 
such a bizarre face?
choice_data_list:
Your mother has a completely different 
vibe from you, Air Groove.

Your mother has a completely different 
vibe from you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...My mother was an instructor whose creed 
was never to give the essential answers, 
but to make students think for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She possesses a grand vision far beyond my 
reach, and her words are always laden with 
profound meaning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thus, it cannot be helped that you do not 
understand. After all, even I am troubled 
like this.

Though her tone was firm, Air Groove's 
expression as she thought of her mother 
looked somewhat tender... and almost 
childlike.

Combined with her feelings toward the 
"Oaks," which I was hearing about for the 
first time, it looked remarkably fresh...
choice_data_list:
In the end, there's nothing left to do but 
run.
In the end, the only thing to do is run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. To think you'd be the one pointing 
that out. ...Still, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as Mother said, today I will give 
everything I have to the Oaks. And then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――I will definitely catch up to the 
"Queen."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for dragging you along. Let's 
start getting ready soon.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The season of fresh young leaves, when 
beauty alone shines with a perilously 
brilliant radiance...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The chosen Umamusume are turning up the 
heat for the one and only Queen's throne!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Can the much-anticipated Air Groove pull 
off a mother-daughter generation sweep!?"
(WOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

The cheers from the stands can be heard 
all the way here. Air Groove is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

Fully locked in, she was overflowing with 
a dignified aura unlike anything seen 
before.
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you for your best run.
I'm counting on you for your best run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will exceed the expectations of 
every single person here today.
The decisive battle begins—!
